title: Raspberry mousse
hookLine: Polish-inspired raspberry mousse with 5 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Raspberry mousse
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the gelatine leaves in a bowl, cover with warm water and leave to soak for 5 mins. Drain and squeeze out any excess water. Keep {m53303_1}, {m53303_2}, {m53303_3}, and {m53303_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure gelatine leafs first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Tip the raspberries into a pan over a medium-low heat along with the sugar and lemon juice. Cook for 5-6 mins until the berries have completely broken down. Push the mixture through a sieve set over a bowl, discarding the seeds. Stir in the gelatine leaves until dissolved (if they don’t dissolve, pour the mixture into a clean saucepan and heat gently until dissolved). Set aside to cool for 15 mins.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53303_4} and {m53303_5} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip the cream to soft peaks using an electric whisk, then gently fold this into the raspberry mixture. Spoon into the ramekins or moulds and chill overnight, or for at least 6 hrs. Serve with raspberries scattered over the top.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
